summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan: ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found on audit (read-only) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus the auth chain (`useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx` router, `db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`).  Everything in the watchlist module itself is correctly wired: - `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` are properly scoped by `user_id`, every handler filters by it. - The client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback exists
